title: You don't need JavaScript for that
summary: Applies the "rule of least power" principle to web development by demonstrating native HTML and CSS solutions (custom switches, datalist, color pickers, details/summary accordions, dialog modals) that eliminate the need for JavaScript implementations.
when-to-read: Read this when evaluating whether a feature genuinely requires JavaScript or can be implemented more efficiently with native HTML/CSS, or when seeking to reduce JavaScript bundle size and improve accessibility. If you're looking for patterns on when and how to use specific frameworks or libraries, consult engineering-management or decision-making articles instead.
